items.title: A presheaf sending finite disjoint unions to products agrees with its sheafification on affine weakly contractible objects
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a presheaf of sets on the pro-etale site which sends finite disjoint unions to products, the value of its sheafification on an affine weakly contractible object equals the value of the presheaf (statement lines 3464-3470). The proof (proof lines 3472-3497) works with the plus construction, checks that it still converts finite disjoint unions into products and uses the refinement of pro-etale coverings of a weakly contractible object by finite disjoint unions to compute the value. H2: two verifications with two inputs, written out in full.
